messages:
maria: Quick check-in on PM-112 postmortem action items 
We have a couple overdue. Owners please confirm status or update ETA.
jon: Which ones are overdue today? I thought we resolved the rollback doc.
sam: Rollback is done. Canary alert and recurrence analysis still open. I left review comments on the alert PR.
olivia: PR is WIP. Hitting a flaky integration test. Will rerun CI and push a fix today. ETA: EOD.
dinesh: I reviewed the alert query; we should add a 5m suppress window to reduce noise during bursty traffic. Happy to review after CI.
maria: Thanks. Also the recurrence analysis was unassigned in the doc. We need someone to own it since we had the same error multiple times this month.
jon: I can take the recurrence analysis. Need access to traces archive. Sam, can you point me to the location?
sam: Traces archived at gs://incidents-archive/pm-112/traces-2024-06.tar.gz
jon: Got it, will run clustering and look for deploy correlation. Will post findings by tomorrow noon.
incident-bot: Reminder: PM-112 actions overdue: canary alert (olivia), recurrence analysis (unassigned). Escalation to eng-directors in 36h if not updated.
maria: Owners and expectations: olivia -> fix CI & merge alert PR (EOD), jon -> recurrence analysis (tomorrow noon), sam -> ensure replay infra access + add smoke job to run alert query daily (INFRA ticket). If any slips, call it out here now.
olivia: Acknowledged. Will update this thread when PR merged or if blocked.
sam: Opening INFRA ticket INFRA-874 for smoke job, ETA 2 weeks. Also granting jon read access to the archive now.
dinesh: I'll queue a quick review after olivia's CI passes. Suggest adding the suppress window as a config knob so ops can tune it.
incident-bot: Escalation queued in 24h for PM-112 unresolved items.
maria: Final: reply with "done" in this thread when each item is closed so I can mark the postmortem complete. I'll escalate to Eng Directors if anything is still open after the escalation timer. Thanks.
